 Kevin Diks ‘to miss’ Stuttgart trip, Gladbach down to one centre-back 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Borussia Mönchengladbach have been dealt a late defensive blow, with Kevin Diks reportedly set to miss Friday night’s Bundesliga trip to VfB Stuttgart.
 Bild reports that he is unavailable for personal reasons, and the club told the paper his absence is not injury-related.
 OneFootball Videos
 The 30-year-old could be back as early as Tuesday’s DFB-Pokal tie at Karlsruher SC.
 Without Diks, Alexander Blessin is left with only one fit natural centre-back, Fabio Chiarodia . Kō Itakura, muscle tear, and Jan Leszczynski, knee sprain, are already sidelined.
 If Blessin persists with a back three, Daiki Hashioka and Philipp Sander could join Chiarodia in central defence. A switch to a back four is also conceivable.
 Gladbach are bottom of the Bundesliga, having lost all six of their league matches this season.
